summary.headline: Children and the Fifth House
summary.text: Instructions for judging maternal fortune by directing the Moon when the Hyleg is absent, followed by Chapter XX on children and the fifth house. The chapter evaluates the house of children, its lord, Venus, Jupiter, the part of children, triplicity lord, malefic impediments, and applications to determine abundance, sterility, illegitimacy, maidservant offspring, and the planetary causes of many or few children.
